mapper.select: select * from nad_application_interview where application_id = #{applicationId} order by id desc
select * from nad_application_interview where application_id = #{applicationId} and status = 'SCHEDULED' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into nad_application_interview (application_id, starts_at, duration_minutes, platform, meeting_url, instructions, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicationId}, #{startsAt}, #{durationMinutes}, #{platform}, #{meetingUrl}, #{instructions}, 'SCHEDULED', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_application_interview set status = 'CANCELLED', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'SCHEDULED'
